taxonomy.description: Remove filler while retaining the technical substance needed to act.
Preserve polarity, limits, numbers, units, code, identifiers, APIs, commands, and quoted errors.
Do not add fake grammar, mode prefixes, invented abbreviations, or causal arrows.
Keep the requested or dominant language and preserve grammatical role markers.
Use complete normal clarity for destructive actions, security, data loss, ambiguity, and ordered recovery.
Keep persisted or external human-facing artifacts in normal prose unless explicitly requested otherwise.
Preserve explicit activation, intensity, persistence, and deactivation boundaries.
